content:
Last year's iPhone 17 Pro 'Cosmic Orange' color option became an instant hit when it launched, but rumors suggest the iPhone 18 Pro will switch to a brand new burgundy color. Here's a preview compiled based on the latest leaks.

iPhone 18 Pro main new color preview

In the past, Apple's Pro series iPhone color options tended to be understated and reserved, but with the launch of the iPhone 17 Pro, Apple made a major change—breaking away from the previous practice of only offering black and white, boldly introducing the eye-catching 'Cosmic Orange' color option, which immediately took the market by storm.

There are rumors that Apple plans to continue this bold style with the iPhone 18 Pro.

However, this time it won't be orange, but rather an expected offering of three (or possibly four) color options:

  • Burgundy / Dark Cherry
  • Blue
  • Silver
  • Possibly Dark Gray

It remains unclear whether there will be a dark gray or black option this year. However, there is already fairly strong consensus on the other three colors.

Among them, the dark cherry / burgundy is expected to become the new signature color that Apple will heavily promote this time.

Leaker Fixed Focus Digital posted on Weibo today, saying they have seen lighter and darker versions of this color leaked, but believe the correct tone is the deeper variation—a purple-toned red, similar to cherry.

Some reports simply refer to this color as 'red' or 'dark red', so some mock-up renders lean toward a lighter, more reddish feel. But according to this leaker, what we'll actually see will be a more purple-toned cherry color.

What are your thoughts on the rumored signature color of the iPhone 18 Pro? Feel free to share in the comments section.
